blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A politician from Mindanao allegedly financed the chartered flight linked to the 521-kilogram shabu seizure in Laos, according to the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA). “We have identified the financier behind this drug operation. This politician is based in the South, in Mindanao,” PDEA spokesperson Atty. Joseph Frederick Calulut told reporters in an interview Thursday. Calulut did not identify the politician but said the individual was opposed to the current administration. He also did not disclose the politician’s position, saying the investigation and case-building were ongoing. /apl/dp Read: PDEA probes another Filipino linked to Laos meth seizure...
